name: ZOOMIT Content Layouts for Elementor
author: Kamrul Hasan

sections.description:
ZOOMIT Content Layouts for Elementor is a feature-rich Elementor addon plugin designed for bloggers, content writers, marketers, and website creators who want to present their articles in a visually attractive way.

The plugin includes 10 unique content designs that help you organize and style your content beautifully inside Elementor without writing any code.

Whether you are creating blog posts, tutorials, affiliate articles, reviews, or landing page content, this plugin helps you improve readability and user engagement.

🎥 Watch Demo Video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eaSU5VHlie8

Features

  • 10 unique content layouts
  • Fully responsive design
  • Easy drag & drop Elementor widgets
  • Typography customization
  • Color customization
  • Icon support
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Clean and modern UI
  • Beginner friendly
  • No coding required

Perfect For

  • Blog articles
  • Product reviews
  • Tutorials
  • Affiliate marketing posts
  • Landing pages
  • News websites
  • Magazine websites
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zoomit-content-layouts-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor plugin is installed and activated.
  4. Open Elementor editor.
  5. Search for “Content Layout” widgets.
  6. Drag and drop your preferred design into the page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

No. The plugin works with the free version of Elementor.

Is the plugin responsive?

Yes, all designs are fully responsive.

Can I customize colors and typography?

Yes. You can fully customize colors, typography, spacing, and more from Elementor controls.

How many content styles are included?

Currently, the plugin includes 10 unique content styles.
